name: Green River — Desolation Canyon
description: An 84-mile permitted float on the Green River from Sand Wash to Swasey's Beach, cutting through Desolation and Gray canyons — among the deepest and most remote in the Lower 48. Expect five to seven days of Class II–III whitewater at typical summer flows, punctuated by long calm stretches, side-canyon hikes to petroglyphs and Fremont ruins, and desert-varnished sandstone walls that rise more than a mile above the water. A quiet, contemplative run that rewards early-season boaters with mild rapids and abundant camping, and pulls Butch Cassidy's outlaw hideouts, homesteader cabins, and one of the darkest night skies in the region into view along the way.
hazards: Long shuttle from Sand Wash to Swasey's Beach
points_of_interest: Jack Creek Rapid (II+): first named drop
Three Fords (III): biggest rapid in Desolation
Rock Creek (II+): named rapid above Florence Creek
Joe Hutch Canyon (II+): final big rapid
